secrets.name: ZYPHUS_CONTROL_TOKEN
secrets.description: Passphrase of your choosing that arms the dashboard's 'Drive the agent' box and the POST /api/agent/task endpoint. Without it remote control refuses every request (the loop keeps running).

secrets.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
secrets.description: Optional. Credential for the built-in 'github' connector (src/agent/integrations.py). A fine-grained token with read access is enough for probing and reading; without it the connector reports 'not set' instead of failing.

secrets.name: SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL
secrets.description: Optional. Incoming-webhook URL for the built-in 'slack' connector, used when a connector has no URL of its own. Without it, 'connector: send' to a slack connector refuses and the rest of the agent is unaffected.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. An OpenAI-compatible API key; when present the agent plans with a real model (src/agent/model_brain.py) instead of the local deliberative brain.
